name: Davidson
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Davidson, NC 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Davidson, NC: the North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade, Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green and Santa at Ben and Jerry's.
lede: Davidson celebrates Christmas on Main Street, with a holiday parade shared with Cornelius, an evening celebration on the Town Green and a Santa visit at the ice cream shop.
celebrates: Davidson's holiday season centers on downtown. The Town of Davidson and the Town of Cornelius share the North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade, which runs south on Main Street, Highway 115, in a route that was modified because of construction. Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green fills three evenings from 6 to 9 pm, and Santa visits Ben and Jerry's at 202 South Main Street on December 8. Davidson Parks and Recreation organizes the parade for the two towns, and the town's news page gives the full route for families planning where to stand.
lastyear: The 2026 holiday parade is the 44th annual North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade, so the 2025 parade was the 43rd, according to the Town of Davidson's news page. The town's 2026 notice says the route is about a mile long and has been modified because of construction, starting at Main Street and Griffith Street. The 2026 parade is set for 1 pm on Saturday, December 5.
facts: The North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade is shared by two lake-area towns, Davidson and Cornelius, which each hold their own holiday celebrations. The 2026 route starts at Main Street and Griffith Street, goes south on Main Street, Highway 115, to South Street and ends near McEver Fields and Davidson Elementary. It is about a mile long, which makes it an easy walk for children.
trains: There is no train ride in Davidson. The closest family train outing we have verified is the North Carolina Transportation Museum in Spencer, in Rowan County, which offers 25-minute train rides and seasonal events including The Polar Express. In Charlotte, the free Polar Express Movie Screening at Romare Bearden Park is on December 12, with festivities at 5 pm and the film at 6 pm.
train_links: Admission from $10, or $20 with a 25-minute train ride, at the old Spencer Shops in Rowan County; the museum lists seasonal events including The Polar Express.
traditions: A Main Street parade shared by Davidson and Cornelius, now in its 44th year.
Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green
Three evenings of holiday events on the Town Green, from 6 to 9 pm.
A Santa visit at the downtown ice cream shop at 202 South Main Street.
kidfact: The North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade is in its 44th year, and its route is about a mile long.
faq: When is the Davidson Christmas parade held each year?

The North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade is a shared event of the Towns of Davidson and Cornelius and is held in early December. Its 2026 edition is the 44th, and the town's news page lists the route and time.
Where does the Davidson parade route run?
The 2026 route starts at Main Street and Griffith Street, runs south on Main Street, Highway 115, to South Street and ends near McEver Fields and Davidson Elementary. It is about a mile long.
Is the Davidson parade free to watch?
Yes. It is a public parade, and families watch from the sidewalks along the route.
Where can kids meet Santa in Davidson?
Santa visits Ben and Jerry's at 202 South Main Street in downtown Davidson on December 8. Check the event page for the cost listed for families.
Is there a Christmas event on the Town Green?
Yes. Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green is held on three evenings from 6 to 9 pm and is listed as free.
sources: Lake Norman Christmas and Holiday Events
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Davidson for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green) through December 8 (Santa at Ben and Jerry's), with the 44th Annual North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Davidson

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Davidson

  • Meet Santa: Santa at Ben and Jerry's in downtown Davidson (December 8)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the 44th Annual North Mecklenburg Holiday Parade (December 5) and Christmas in Davidson on the Town Green
